add_row.description: Add a new row to a Coda table.
add_row.display_str_template: Add a row to table '{1}' in doc '{0}'.
add_row.name: add_row

parameters.description: The ID of the Coda doc. Use the List docs action to find it.
parameters.name: doc_id

parameters.description: The ID of the table. Use the List tables in a doc action to find it.
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.description: Column values for the new row
parameters.name: row_values

returns.description: Response confirming the row was queued for insertion.

requestId.description: Coda request ID for tracking the mutation status

list_docs.description: Retrieve all accessible Coda docs for the connected account.
list_docs.name: list_docs

returns.description: Response object. Access items via the 'docs' property.

docs.description: Array of doc objects. Access with response.docs[index]

list_rows.description: Retrieve rows from a Coda table, with an optional limit on how many to return.
list_rows.display_str_template: List rows from table '{1}' in doc '{0}'.
list_rows.name: list_rows

parameters.description: The ID of the Coda doc. Use the List docs action to find it.
parameters.name: doc_id

parameters.description: The ID of the table. Use the List tables in a doc action to find it.
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return
parameters.name: limit

returns.description: Response object. Access items via the 'rows' property.

rows.description: Array of row objects. Access with response.rows[index]

list_tables.description: Fetch all tables for a specific Coda doc.
list_tables.name: list_tables

parameters.description: The ID of the Coda doc. Use the List docs action to find it.
parameters.name: doc_id

returns.description: Response object. Access items via the 'tables' property.

tables.description: Array of table objects. Access with response.tables[index]

update_row.description: Update an existing row in a Coda table.
update_row.name: update_row

parameters.description: The ID of the Coda doc. Use the List docs action to find it.
parameters.name: doc_id

parameters.description: The ID of the table. Use the List tables in a doc action to find it.
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.description: The ID of the row to update. Use the List rows action to find it.
parameters.name: row_id

parameters.description: Column values to update on the row
parameters.name: row_values

returns.description: Response confirming the row update was queued.

id.description: The row ID that was updated

requestId.description: Coda request ID for tracking the mutation status

description: Access Coda docs, tables, and rows.
